name: Tortoise
soul: The soul of one who has never been hurried into anything, and remembers everyone who tried.
spark: The mote does not circle. It finds one place near you and stays there until you move, and then it is late.

hybrid.text: It has outlasted everything it has met so far by not hurrying.

settled.name: Tortoise hatchling
settled.text: A shell the size of your palm, with a head that comes out when it has decided to. It is in no hurry and never has been.
settled.sign: A shell the size of your palm. The head comes out a little at a time, to see if it was worth it.
settled.habit: It walks to the one warm flagstone in any room and stays there until carried.

paths.name: Stone-back
paths.of: one who will not be moved once they have decided
paths.text: It learned from you that being moved is something a person agrees to, and that you have not yet agreed.
paths.sign: Its shell has gone the grey of fieldstone, and it sets its feet before it does anything.
paths.habit: It stops in doorways to think. People go round.

prongs.name: Ridge-shell
prongs.of: one who is marked by every time they would not give way
prongs.text: Each blow it took for you raised a ridge on its shell. It is nearly all ridges.
prongs.sign: A row of raised ridges runs down its shell, one for each blow it stood under.
prongs.habit: It rubs its shell along the doorframe, ridge by ridge, as if counting.

finishes.name: Hundred-scar
finishes.of: one who can show you the cost of every stand
finishes.text: You could read your whole first year off its shell, if you could bear to.
finishes.sign: Its shell is dark iron crossed with pale lines, like a slate nobody has wiped.
finishes.habit: It lies in the sun with the worst side up.

finishes.name: Anvil-back
finishes.text: What strikes it rings, and for a moment cannot lift its weapon again.
finishes.sign: A flat bright plate on the crown of its shell, dented and ringing.
finishes.habit: It lets the smith's apprentice practise on it and does not look round.

prongs.name: Ward-shell
prongs.of: one who carries their rules with them
prongs.text: Your wards are cut into its shell now, and it carries them where you cannot stay.
prongs.sign: Ward-lines are cut round the rim of its shell and glow faintly when it stops.
prongs.habit: Wherever it stops it turns once in place first, and then that is where it is.

finishes.name: Ward on Four Legs
finishes.of: one who is a safe place by standing still
finishes.text: Where it stops there is a post, whether the Compact built one or not.
finishes.sign: The air over its shell stands like glass on a hot day, and dust does not cross it.
finishes.habit: It settles in the middle of the camp, and the camp arranges itself round it.

finishes.name: Sworn Stone
finishes.of: one who was there and will say what was said
finishes.text: Your Terms are carved on it. It was the witness, and stone does not forget its lines.
finishes.sign: Your Terms are cut in the underside of its shell, small and deep. It shows them only when asked.
finishes.habit: Once a season it rolls onto its back by the fire, slowly, and lets you read.

prongs.name: Counter-biter
prongs.of: one who waits out the shouting and then answers once
prongs.text: It waits in its shell through the strike and comes out on the foe's recovery, as you do.
prongs.sign: Its head is drawn half in, and the beak shows at the edge of the shell like a latch.
prongs.habit: It watches a fly circle for an hour. There is then no fly.

finishes.name: Second-beat Snapper
finishes.of: one who has the last word, late
finishes.text: It bites on the beat after your Pattern ends, when the foe thinks it is over.
finishes.sign: A ring of pale light closes round its jaw a beat after you would expect.
finishes.habit: It shuts its mouth a moment after everyone has stopped talking.

finishes.name: Patient Jaw
finishes.of: one who has never let go of anything
finishes.text: It has let go of nothing it ever took hold of. One of them is still attached.
finishes.sign: A length of chain trails from its beak. It has not opened its mouth to drop it.
finishes.habit: It holds one end of a rope for you all day and does not ask why.

paths.name: Cairn-back
paths.of: one who is the same every day, and can be set a clock by
paths.text: It learned from you to be in the same place at the same hour. Travellers stack a stone on it at every post, and it has stopped shaking them off.
paths.sign: A small cairn of pebbles rides on its shell. None has fallen off.
paths.habit: It leaves at the same minute each morning, and the walkers check the post clock by it.

prongs.name: Waymark Tortoise
prongs.of: one who keeps to the stopping places
prongs.text: It stops at every post you have relit, for exactly as long as it did the last time. The walkers have begun to count from it.
prongs.sign: The plates of its shell are worn like the face of a dial, and its shadow tells the hour.
prongs.habit: It will not pass a post without stopping, even one that is dark.

finishes.name: Keystone of the Post
finishes.of: one the whole arrangement turns out to rest on
finishes.text: It settles beside a post and the post's flame stops guttering. The Compact has asked to borrow it.
finishes.sign: A post lamp is bolted to its shell. The Compact did it, and it did not object.
finishes.habit: It sleeps against the foot of the lamp-iron, and the flame stands straight.

finishes.name: Old Milestone
finishes.of: one by whom others measure how far they have come
finishes.text: It has been at every post you relit. The walkers count the line by it now.
finishes.sign: A number is cut in its shell, and repainted each year by somebody.
finishes.habit: Each evening it looks for a long time down the line, the way you came.

prongs.name: House-carrier
prongs.of: one who carries what the others set down
prongs.text: The party's packs ride on its shell. So, on bad days, does the party.
prongs.sign: Strap marks are worn across its shell, and it holds its back very level.
prongs.habit: It stands still to be loaded, and waits to be asked before it moves.

finishes.name: Wagon-tortoise
finishes.of: one who gets everyone there at the same pace as yesterday
finishes.text: The passenger rides. It has never dropped one and never hurried one.
finishes.sign: Two small wheels are fitted under the hind edge of its shell. It ignores them and they work.
finishes.habit: It stops for anyone who puts a hand out.

finishes.name: Hearth-on-its-back
finishes.of: one who became the place where the others gather
finishes.text: Your cohort built a fire-pan on its shell one cold night. It has kept the coals in ever since.
finishes.sign: An iron fire-pan is set in the hollow of its shell with coals in it. Its neck is sooty.
finishes.habit: It walks to the middle of the room at dusk and stops, and people bring stools.

prongs.name: Hearth-elder
prongs.of: one who keeps the old hours for those who kept them first
prongs.text: The shades talk to it as to one of their own that has not died yet.
prongs.sign: A cold light shows between its plates. The shades give it room, and it gives them time.
prongs.habit: It nods, very slowly, at chairs with nobody in them.

finishes.name: Tortoise of the Old Hall
finishes.of: one who remembers everyone by name
finishes.text: It knows the dead of your hall by name, and walks to each of their places at the lamp hour.
finishes.sign: Names are scratched small along the rim of its shell, and a few of them are faintly lit.
finishes.habit: At the lamp hour it walks to each of the old places in turn. It has not missed one.

finishes.name: Still Shell
finishes.of: one who has a quiet they can lend
finishes.text: In the Quiet it draws in its head and the silence stops at its shell. Sit close.
finishes.sign: With its head in it looks like a river stone. The air above it is very still.
finishes.habit: It draws in its head when the talk gets loud, and the talk gets quieter.

paths.name: The Unhurried
paths.of: one who loves the long way round and arrives anyway
paths.text: It learned from you that the long way round is still a way. It has never run, and it has not yet failed to arrive.
paths.sign: Its claws are worn short and its shell is travel-stained to the rim. It does not look tired.
paths.habit: Offered two roads it takes the longer, and looks at things on the way.

prongs.name: Map-back
prongs.of: one who is making a record of everywhere they have been
prongs.text: The lines on its shell have begun to match the zones you have walked. The unwalked parts are filling in.
prongs.sign: The lines on its shell are a map. New country comes in at the leading edge.
prongs.habit: It turns to face the way you came and holds still, as if copying.

finishes.name: Chart of the Deep
finishes.of: one who knows the way out because they went all the way in
finishes.text: Its shell shows the heart of every zone and the one way out. Varga has copied it twice.
finishes.sign: A small brass dial is set in its shell, and the needle points at the way out.
finishes.habit: At a fork it sits down, and after a while it is facing one branch.

finishes.name: Salvor's Tortoise
finishes.of: one who waits on the right spot until the others catch up
finishes.text: It sits down on the spot where the thing is buried, every time, and waits for you to notice.
finishes.sign: It tilts its head to the ground like someone listening at a door.
finishes.habit: It sits down on the one loose flagstone in a yard and looks at you.

prongs.name: Den-breaker
prongs.of: one who walks in at their own pace and lets the other decide
prongs.text: It walks into a den the way it walks everywhere. The den's owner has to decide what to do about that.
prongs.sign: A blunt horn of shell stands over its brow, and its front is scraped from doorways.
prongs.habit: It walks into rooms it was not asked into, at the speed it does everything.

finishes.name: Trophy-shell
finishes.of: one who decides for themselves what was worth keeping
finishes.text: A tooth from every named beast is set in its shell. It chose where each one goes.
finishes.sign: A ring of great teeth is set round the crown of its shell, each in a place it chose.
finishes.habit: Some evenings it has you move one tooth to a new place, and considers the result.

finishes.name: Moss-back
finishes.of: one who has outlasted everything they ever followed
finishes.text: It has crossed the green so slowly that the green came with it. What it follows grows tired of looking back.
finishes.sign: Moss and small ferns grow on its shell, and a seedling has taken root at the back.
finishes.habit: It stands out in the rain on purpose, for the garden's sake.

prongs.name: Mud-lier
prongs.of: one who can wait in plain sight
prongs.text: It lies in the shallows looking like the bank until something steps on the bank.
prongs.sign: Mud to the eyes, and webbed feet tucked under. Only the nostrils show it is not the bank.
prongs.habit: It settles into any puddle and is mistaken for a stone by evening.

finishes.name: River-jaw
finishes.of: one who is known along a whole river for one thing done well
finishes.text: The river towns name the things it has pulled under. The list is short and the things were large.
finishes.sign: A finned keel runs down its tail, and its beak is notched from large bones.
finishes.habit: It floats with only its eyes out and drifts wherever the current is slowest.

finishes.name: Bog-lure
finishes.of: one who lets the trouble come to them
finishes.text: A light on its beak hangs over black water. What comes to the light does not see the rest of it.
finishes.sign: A small light hangs from its lower jaw on a stalk. The rest is the colour of the water.
finishes.habit: It lies at the edge of the lamplight with its mouth a little open.

newFeatures.label: a shell scored like a map
